title: Shihou-sashi-shikuchi
guidance: Four 床梁 frame into one post at a single level. Two through-tenons cannot share a core, so each beam's 竿 is cut at its own level within the beam's depth: the two x beams stack in the lower half, the two z beams in the upper half. Each tenon passes clean through the post and 30 mm into the end of the beam opposite, so the four beams tie one another, and a plate komisen dropped through each pair of tenons from the post's top face, standing a little proud, pins the lot.
